title: Implement fixed 17-operation system with locked operation list - Frontend

requirements.summary: Update ContainerDailyReportEntryPage to display all 17 predefined operations in exact sequential order (1-17), fetching data from getAllOperations backend function
acceptanceCriteria: Table displays exactly 17 rows in sequential order
Each row shows the correct operation_id (1-17) and operation_name

Operations are displayed in the exact order: Boxing, Welding/Finishing, Rear Wall, Front Wall, Side Wall, Roof, Rear Door, Blasting & Primer, Final Paint, Gasket, DLM, Plywood, Floor Screw, Decal, Data Plate, Sikha, Black Paint
All 17 rows are visible even if no production data exists for some operations

file_operations.description: Modify the page to fetch all 17 operations using useGetAllOperations hook and display them in sequential order (1-17) in the production entry table. Ensure all 17 operations are always visible as rows, even when no production data exists for some operations. The table should display operation_id and operation_name for each row, maintaining the predefined order from the backend.

requirements.summary: Update ContainerDailyReportPage to display all 17 predefined operations in exact sequential order (1-17), showing zero or empty values for operations with no production data
acceptanceCriteria: Report table displays exactly 17 rows in sequential order
All operations from 1-17 are visible regardless of data availability
Operations without data show zero or empty values
Operations are displayed in the predefined order

file_operations.description: Modify the page to fetch all 17 operations using useGetAllOperations hook and display them in sequential order (1-17) in the daily report table. For operations without production data for the selected date, display zero or empty values. Ensure the Excel-style table always shows all 17 rows with columns for operation name, today's production, total completed, despatch, and in-hand values.

requirements.summary: Update all production dashboard and history components to display operations in the predefined sequential order (1-17) when showing production data
acceptanceCriteria: All components display operations in sequential order 1-17
Operation names are fetched from the Operations table via backend
No custom operation names or out-of-order operations appear
Sorting by operation maintains the 1-17 sequence

file_operations.description: Ensure that all production data displayed on the dashboard uses operation_id for sorting (1-17 sequential order) and operation_name from the backend Operations data. Verify that charts and tables displaying operation-level data maintain the predefined sequence.

Ensure the production history table displays operations in sequential order (1-17) when showing production data. Use operation_id for sorting and operation_name fetched from the backend. The filter dropdown for operations should also display them in the predefined order.

Ensure the production dashboard table displays operations in sequential order (1-17) using operation_id for sorting. Operation names should be fetched from the backend Operations data and displayed in the predefined sequence.

Ensure the daily production report table displays operations in sequential order (1-17) when showing production data. Use operation_id for sorting and operation_name from backend. Maintain the predefined sequence even when applying filters or sorting.

Ensure the operation comparison chart displays operations in sequential order (1-17) on the x-axis using operation_id for ordering and operation_name for labels. The chart should maintain the predefined sequence from backend data.

requirements.summary: Ensure the useGetAllOperations React Query hook correctly fetches all 17 operations from the backend with proper error handling and returns operations in sequential order
acceptanceCriteria: Hook fetches data from getAllOperations backend function
Hook returns exactly 17 operations in sequential order
Hook handles loading state properly
Hook handles error state properly
Operations data is cached appropriately

file_operations.description: Verify and ensure the hook correctly fetches all 17 operations from the backend getAllOperations function. Ensure proper error handling, loading states, and appropriate caching (5-minute stale time as currently configured). The hook should return operations in sequential order by operation_id (1-17) if not already sorted by the backend.

requirements.summary: Add comprehensive validation in ContainerDailyReportEntryPage save functionality to ensure all production records reference valid operation_ids (1-17)
acceptanceCriteria: Save function validates all operation_ids are between 1-17
Save function shows error toast for invalid operation_ids
Save function prevents submission of invalid data
User receives clear feedback on validation errors

file_operations.description: Add validation logic to the save functionality to ensure all production records being saved reference valid operation_ids between 1 and 17 inclusive. If any invalid operation_id is detected, prevent submission and display a user-friendly error message using a toast notification. Ensure users receive clear feedback on what went wrong.
